findings.text: _defer_to_a_queued_review requires the review's own request to be in PENDING, but _mark_waiting writes that request at promotion-waiting (line 177), so a run refused only for a review whose review-self request is parked is refused terminally instead of requeued: a run refused for the absent review while the reviewer is still writing matches the aggregate text, sets no other reason, and the earlier-is-queued branch at line 371 sees no PENDING request reviewing it. The requeue the node exists to provide is therefore lost in exactly the window the merged primary-branch wait opens, and no test composes the park with the requeue. The merged commit b5e7eb24's fragment states the two behaviours are kept in one loop, but this composition case is not covered. Remedy: treat WAITING as queued for this predicate.

PromotionService.wait_for_in_flight repeats the deadline-join loop PromotionService.settle already owns at line 594 in the same class: both walk self._threads joining each within a monotonic deadline. The two differ only in that one prunes and returns the survivors. One should build on the other so the join policy has one owner.

The 'Gate, head arm ... final head f5568d40' row (55 passed in 12.45 s) cites gate-sbatch.log, which records the job id, cwd, counts and EXIT= but no revision and no command line, so the head that row names cannot be checked from the artefact. The rows this node added (merged head 9b88b8b4 and 62-passed composition) are checkable: gate-head.log:1 and merge-precheck.log:1 name their revisions and commands. This is the finding the prior review of this run raised at this line and the gained commits did not repair.

The table caption claims every gate log names its revision, tree, literal command, 'the module actually imported and its working directory'; gate-head.log and gate-base.log carry revision, tree and command but no module.__file__ or resolved-cwd line, and gate-sbatch.log carries none of the four. The caption overstates what the retained logs hold.

The node declares docs/figures/work-flows-to-the-lane/review-promoted-before-its-run and shipped no figure; the four-way ordering (review queued, run queued, refusal, requeue) the fragment now also describes as composed with the primary branch's park is a diagram the graphics mandate expects. Carried from the prior review; the gained docs commits added prose about the merged loop without the figure.
